text:
alex: Need a small profiling handoff on kv-prefetch branch. Can someone capture an nsys qdrep + torch.profiler JSON so I can build a flamegraph? B=1 seq=128, short run.

maria: I can do it on dev-A5000. How many iterations?

alex: 2 warmup, 5 steps measured. Set KV_PREFETCH=1. Also want module-level stacks if possible.

jonathan: For combined capture use:
```
NSYS="nsys profile -o /tmp/prefetch -t cuda,osrt --sample=cpu"
$NSYS python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=1 run_infer.py --seq 128 --batch 1 --warmup 2 --steps 5 --kv-prefetch
```
then:
```
python tools/merge_qdrep.py /tmp/prefetch.qdrep torch_profiler.json --out flame.json
```
Note: add record_shapes=True and with_stack=True to profiler.

maria: running now, will scrub file names and remove IPs before upload. ETA 10m :hourglass: 

perf-bot: Tip: use --sample=cpu to keep qdrep size down. Keep under 100MB or split captures.

maria: uploaded to s3://redwood-perf-handoff/records/2129876543/trace.qdrep and s3://redwood-perf-handoff/records/2129876543/flame.json. perms set for eng-runtime team.

jonathan: grabbed it. First glance: prefetch kernels fire earlier but there's a memcpy chunk right after prefetch that may block overlap. I'll diff vs main and comment on the PR.

alex: if you see KV cache miss rate spike open bisect thread. Otherwise i'll paste flame snippet into PR review and suggest a quick patch.

maria: no cache miss spike on this seed. Happy to rerun with batch=2 if helpful.

alex: thanks all. Closing this handoff. :white_check_mark:
